tags.helperText: Add tags to help categorize and find your course easily

placeholders.courseOverview: Provide a detailed overview of the course. Include learning objectives, topics covered, format (video, quizzes, projects), and who this course is for.

coursePreview.label: Course Preview Image
coursePreview.helperText: This is the thumbnail that appears on the course card. Recommended size: 2:1 ratio

courseBanner.label: Course Banner Image
courseBanner.helperText: A wide background image displayed on top of the course detail page. Recommended size: 2.64:1 ratio

courseMedia.label: Course Media (Image or Video)
courseMedia.helperText: A featured media block within the course page; this can visually represent the content or offer a teaser. For videos, recommended format: MP4
courseMedia.videoUnsupported: Your browser does not support the video tag.
